title: mentha sylvestris var. villosa
intro: Mentha sylvestris var. villosa, commonly known as Woolly Wild Mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant that is native to Europe and parts of Asia. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, including providing relief from digestive issues, nausea, and headaches, due to its numerous health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant, which contribute to its uses in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Woolly Wild Mint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and aroma.
